{\Large Order-Dependent Flaky Tests in Java Projects}\\[1ex]
Anonymous Author(s)

\visibleintro

Two reports to the Quill project describe the first flaky tests that the study found.

https://github.com/quillbuild/quill/issues/412

https://github.com/quillbuild/quill/issues/518

The reruns use the Tessera runner [1] on the Harbor service [2], and the scripts are archived [3].
